name: Jan Regulus
source:
"I heard you haven’t been eating. Here, it’s a surprise present, just for you..."

A researcher at the STX Space Force’s R&D Center, he is the creator and father figure to all of neo-fennec kind. He is friendly from a distance, but given to icy stares, hence the moniker "Hatred-Digesting Boa Constrictor."

Hates Ichizo for nominating a certain young pilot for the "Honorable Interstellar Plan" of 339 UBE.

He ostensibly oversees neo-fennec population control, but in secret, he is investigating a 5th-dimensional ghost on Battleship Baobab said to drift through the library of time.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2051100]Steam[/url]]
